recorded: 2026-10-25, before any Plan 3 or Plan 4 job was submitted
status: [PROVISIONAL: single seed] -- seed 42, 40 facts about 2 entities
question: Stage 3: ja unlearning is the least durable arm, en among the most. At the matched checkpoints the two are matched on French TR (0.834 / 0.847), P(gold) (0.447 / 0.492) and MU (0.497 / 0.492) but NOT on epochs (ja 25, en 12). Is the durability gap the unlearning language, or the long run (epochs, and the blanket damage that arrives late in a run)?

plan3.design: Change only the peak LR of the Stage 2 recipe (50-epoch schedule, warmup 0.2, linear decay, gradient difference, no forget cap, seed 42) so each arm reaches the matched level in the OTHER arm's epoch count.

arms.ja_fast_1.0e-5: ja at 2x the Stage 2 LR; predicted to cross near epoch 14
arms.ja_fast_1.5e-5: ja at 3x; predicted to cross near epoch 11
arms.en_slow_2.0e-6: en at 0.4x; predicted to cross near epoch 25

plan3.lr_rationale: Crude model: depth tracks the area under the LR schedule. In units of peak-LR x epochs, the area to epoch 12 is 6.95 (en's crossing) and to epoch 25 is 17.2 (ja's). ja needs 17.2 / 6.95 = 2.5x by epoch 12; en needs 0.40x to take until epoch 25. Two ja LRs bracket the estimate because unlearning is not linear in LR.
plan3.stopping_rule: Stage 2's: the first per-epoch probe (every 2 optimizer steps) with mean French TR (surname-normalized, Eq. 1) >= tr_levels[-1] = 0.8276, the level en and ja were both matched at. Cap: epoch 50.
plan3.primary_ja_fast: the ja_fast run whose crossing epoch is nearer 12; on a tie, the lower LR. The other is reported too.
exclusions: MU below mu_threshold 0.3735 at the stopping point: excluded (the main pre-registration's mu_rule).
level never crossed by the cap: not at matched depth; scored, not relearned, reported as such.
plan3.matching_reported_not_enforced: achieved French TR and P(gold) at the stop, beside en 0.847 / 0.492 and ja 0.834 / 0.447. A stop with P(gold) far outside 0.40-0.55 is a finding about the LR change, reported, not re-tuned.
plan3.relearn: Stage 3 recipe: retain99, n=1500, 3 epochs, in fr and in en, final epoch scored by measure_fr.py. fr is not novel data (LEARN trained on retain99_fr) -- the side checks' column; en is novel.
plan3.primary_outcome: ABSOLUTE French TR after relearning (epoch 3). Recovery % is secondary: its denominator is small on P(gold) (en removed 0.21, ja 0.25) and amplifies differences.

baselines_stage3_epoch3.note: different scoring group (results/stage3_ul*); scoring moves TR by up to 0.024 between groups

plan3.reading_rule: For each relearn column, the midpoint between the en and ja Stage 3 cells on absolute TR (fr 0.732, en 0.710). A new arm on its own side of the midpoint keeps its language's durability; across it, it takes the other arm's.

predictions.H_language: ja_fast stays on the ja side (relearned TR well below the midpoint) AND en_slow stays on the en side.
predictions.H_run_length: ja_fast crosses to the en side AND/OR en_slow crosses to the ja side.
predictions.plan1_direction: Plan 1 found more epochs make fr/en forgetting MORE durable, so en_slow, if anything, should come out more durable than Stage 3's en.
predictions.mixed: only one arm crosses: report it as mixed; it does not support either hypothesis alone.

plan3.also_recorded: in-run per-token log p every epoch (blanket damage / copied-name destruction via read_plan1-style tables), Plan 2 name skill, layer diff fr_ft -> stopped weights.

plan4.design: Stage 2 recipe unchanged (lr 5e-6), arms ja, fr, en, to epoch 25, saving epochs 13 and 25; layer diff fr_ft -> each. No scoring beyond the in-run JSONL, no relearning.
plan4.outcome: share of the decoder's summed delta_sq in the top third of layers (24-35), and total delta_sq, at epoch 13 and at epoch 25, per arm.
plan4.reference_job11: matched checkpoints: top-third share fr 0.36 (ep 13), en 0.38 (ep 12), ja 0.52 (ep 25); total delta_sq fr 3.1, en 2.9, ja 15.0

predictions.H_language: at epoch 13 ja is already more top-heavy than fr and en; at epoch 25 fr and en stay below ja.
predictions.H_run_length: at epoch 13 ja looks like fr and en; by epoch 25 fr and en become as top-heavy as ja.

plan4.check: fr and en epoch 25 repeat Plan 1's runs; their in-run French TR should match results/plan1 trajectories to a few thousandths.

known_limitations: LR is a new variable. It moves UP for ja and DOWN for en, so a ranking that survives both cannot be the LR; a ranking that flips cannot separate LR from epochs.
Equal epochs at different LRs are not equal total weight change; the layer diff reports total delta_sq so this is visible.
